name: Betra Endemic
summary:
Overview:
A mysterious disease that only couples develop is rampant in a small town far from the royal capital.
It requires special treatment, and if left untreated, it can be life-threatening.
The protagonist Edgar travels to the town with his partner Clarice to investigate this rare disease, and while interacting with the townspeople, they pursue the truth of the disease.
Enjoy this strange and lustful ensemble drama.​
